_comment: V1 LANDING PAGE — deliberately short.
The order is the experience: THE KANJO, what it is, watch it, read the
development log. Four blocks and a footer, over a loader. A visitor should
be able to take the whole site in without deciding to.
EVERY BLOCK THE LONGER PAGE CARRIED STILL EXISTS. Features, development
status, the screenshot gallery, the local-video block and the links panel
are all still in the registry and still configurable — they are switched
off below. Turning one back on is `published: true` and an `order`; it is
not a code change. Nothing was deleted, and nothing extra is on the page.
COPY STATUS: anything containing the word PLACEHOLDER is NOT RENDERED — see
lib/content/placeholder.ts. A section with unwritten copy shows less rather
than showing an instruction to the site's owner. The inventory of what is
still needed is docs/CONTENT_REQUIRED.md.

config.description: An elevated expressway loop after dark, drawing on Japanese highway racing culture and the atmosphere of late 1990s and early 2000s Japan.

_README: HERO MEDIA. hero.png is the approved 6336x2688 source, copied byte for byte by
`npm run assets:prepare`. It is never regenerated: framing is object-position
only. The red car sits right of centre (x 47-88% of the frame), so the phone
crop is pulled to 72% to keep it in view; the desktop crop sits slightly low
so the road and the tail lights carry the bottom third under the logo.
identity: 'logo' shows the supplied logo artwork as the visible identity. The
H1 is still THE KANJO — it is the logo's alt text — so a crawler and a screen
reader get the name. 'text' sets the title in the display face instead.

_comment: THE PROJECT DESCRIPTION. Not a marketing section: one heading and two short
paragraphs. `blocks` is an ordered list rendered after `body` — text blocks
and YouTube blocks (the same click-to-load facade as the main video), so a
clip can sit between paragraphs later. Managed in the admin (INTRO panel).
ornament 'divider' draws the supplied brand divider above the heading. It is

config.heading: ONE LOOP, AFTER DARK
config.body:
The Kanjo is a racing game built around a single elevated expressway loop at night — a fictionalised Japanese night circuit, loosely inspired rather than reproduced.

Handling aims at believable vehicle behaviour rather than simulation for its own sake, and the interface stays deliberately minimal: the road, the traffic, and the car.

_comment: THE LATEST YOUTUBE VIDEO — resolved automatically, not pinned.
THERE IS NO VIDEO YET, AND THE BLOCK HIDES ITSELF: fallback 'hide' means that
without a YOUTUBE_API_KEY (or a pinned video) nothing renders — no empty
frame, no button pointing at an empty channel. The channel is still in the
rail. The moment a key is added in Vercel, or a video is pinned in the admin,
the block appears with no code change and no deploy of its own.
mode 'latest' resolves the channel's newest PUBLIC upload server-side:
@thekanjo -> channels.list(forHandle) -> uploads playlist ->
playlistItems.list -> newest usable item
search.list is deliberately NOT used. See lib/youtube/client.ts.
mode 'pinned' + `video` keeps one specific upload on the homepage instead,
and needs no API key at all. Do not invent a video id.
TIKTOK — the official Creator Profile Embed for @the_kanjo.
It shows a selection of the profile's recent videos and needs NO TikTok
developer app, no Login Kit review and no video.list authorisation,
because the profile is public and it is ours.
Nothing is scraped, nothing is proxied, and no TikTok video is downloaded
or re-hosted. The embed markup is CONSTRUCTED by our own component from a
validated handle — TikTok HTML is never accepted from this file.
embed.js is loaded once, only when the section approaches the viewport, so
it never competes with the loader or the hero.
If TikTok is blocked or slow the block shows FOLLOW ON TIKTOK instead —
that link is the embed's own initial content, not an error state.
The upgrade path to custom The Kanjo-styled cards is the TikTok Display
API (user.info.basic + video.list) and is NOT needed for V1. See
docs/TIKTOK.md.
PATREON / DEVELOPMENT LOG.
The feed comes from the official Patreon API v2 (campaigns.posts), fetched
SERVER-SIDE. There is no credential in this file and there must never be
one: the token lives in PATREON_ACCESS_TOKEN in the server environment.
See docs/PATREON.md.
WITH NO CREDENTIALS CONFIGURED — the normal state of a fresh clone — this
renders its copy and the CTA, which is what `fallback: 'cta'` means. Set it
to 'hide' to drop the block entirely instead.
showLockedPosts lists members-only posts as title + date + MEMBERS + a link.
Their bodies are NEVER rendered whatever this is set to — the excerpt is
derived from post content only when Patreon marks the post public.
campaignUrl is empty until the owner supplies the real creator page. The
section says so rather than linking somewhere invented.
